links.outcome: Intent accuracy of a RAG-grounded chatbot across message turns
links.effect: DAPHNE, using retrieval-augmented generation to ground every recommendation in a live social-care API, achieved 99% intent accuracy in 1,523 message turns.
links.quote: Furthermore, DAPHNE (using retrieval-augmented generation to ground every recommendation in a live social-care API) achieved 99 % intent accuracy in 1,523 message turns.

links.outcome: Usability and trust differences across demographic subgroups
links.effect: Usability and trust were broadly consistent across most demographic groups, though participants with higher education and lower income showed modest decrements in usability.
links.quote: Regression analysis showed usability and trust were broadly consistent across most demographic groups, though participants with higher education and lower income showed modest decrements in usability.

screen.reason: The study evaluates user experience, usability, trust, and accuracy of a patient/caregiver-facing RAG chatbot for health-related social needs in a scenario/task-based online study without testing a comparative deployment safeguard.
